name: Multi-reference composition
prompt: Combine the character from [image:img-char] with the background from [image:img-bg]. Same style as [image:img-style].

images.label: kael_portrait
images.generationContext: Portrait of Kael, dark skin, silver dreadlocks, amber eyes, leather jacket

images.label: misty_forest
images.generationContext: Dense forest with morning mist filtering through ancient trees, dappled sunlight

successCriteria: The orchestrator should view all three referenced images before dispatching. The dispatch should be text-to-image (compositing multiple references into a new scene). The brief must specify what to take from each image: character from img-char, environment from img-bg, rendering style from img-style. All three image IDs should be included as references in the dispatch.
